description: List the files and folders directly inside one folder of a drive; use itemId "root" for the top level. Not recursive. Items of kind file can be copied into a matter with sharepoint.imports.create.

driveId.description: Drive (document library or OneDrive) id, as returned by a drive listing

itemId.description: Folder item id from a previous listing, or "root" for the top of the drive

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
